library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
setwd('C:/Users/Action Lab/OneDrive - Northeastern University/Desktop/OneDrive - Northeastern University/Action Lab/Arm Raising/Armlifting/MATLAB/FinalFiles/SubmissionFiles')

## ====================================================
#  Age and sex stats
# =====================================================
sexAndAge <- read.csv('sexAndAge.txt')

lm_age <- lm(AGE ~ GROUP + (1|SUBJ_NUM), sexAndAge, REML=TRUE)
summary(lm_age)
anova(lm_age)

str(sexAndAge)
table(sexAndAge$GROUP, sexAndAge$SEX, useNA = "ifany")
tab <- table(sexAndAge$GROUP, sexAndAge$SEX)
fisher.test(tab)

## ====================================================
#  Control task stats
# =====================================================
controlRT <- read.csv('controlRT.txt')

lm_controlRT <- lmer(TRIAL_RT ~ GROUP + (1|SUBJ_NUM), controlRT, REML=TRUE)
summary(lm_controlRT)
anova(lm_controlRT)

controlPosture <- read.csv('controlPosture.txt')

lm_controlPosture1 <- lmer(SWAY ~ CONDITION + GROUP + (1+CONDITION|SUBJ_NUM), controlPosture, REML=FALSE)
lm_controlPosture2 <- lmer(SWAY ~ CONDITION * GROUP + (1+CONDITION|SUBJ_NUM), controlPosture, REML=FALSE)
lm_controlPosture3 <- lmer(SWAY ~ CONDITION + GROUP + (1|SUBJ_NUM), controlPosture, REML=FALSE)
lm_controlPosture4 <- lmer(SWAY ~ CONDITION * GROUP + (1|SUBJ_NUM), controlPosture, REML=FALSE)

anova(lm_controlPosture1, lm_controlPosture2, lm_controlPosture3, lm_controlPosture4)

lm_controlPosture <- lmer(SWAY ~ CONDITION * GROUP + (1+CONDITION|SUBJ_NUM), controlPosture, REML=TRUE)
summary(lm_controlPosture)
anova(lm_controlPosture)

em_PG <- emmeans(lm_controlPosture, ~GROUP | CONDITION)
print(em_PG)
print(pairs(em_PG, adjust='Holm'))

## ====================================================
#  Kinematics stats
# =====================================================
reactionTimeData <- read.csv('reactionTime_long.txt')
lm_rt <- lmer(ReactionTime ~ Group + (1|Subject), reactionTimeData, REML=TRUE)
summary(lm_rt)
anova(lm_rt)

em_Group <- emmeans(lm_rt, ~Group)
print(em_Group)

kinematicsResults <- read.csv('kinematicsTable.txt')

lm_peakMag <- lmer(PEAK_MAG ~ GROUP + (1|SUBJ_NUM), kinematicsResults, REML=TRUE)
summary(lm_peakMag)
anova(lm_peakMag)

lm_mt <- lmer(MT ~ GROUP + (1|SUBJ_NUM), kinematicsResults, REML=TRUE)
summary(lm_mt)
anova(lm_mt)

em_Group <- emmeans(lm_mt, ~GROUP)
print(em_Group)

kinematicsPhases <- read.csv('kinematicsLong.txt')

lm_kinPhase1 <- lmer(VALUE ~ GROUP*PHASE + (1+GROUP||SUBJ_NUM), kinematicsPhases, REML=FALSE)
lm_kinPhase2 <- lmer(VALUE ~ GROUP+PHASE + (1+GROUP|SUBJ_NUM), kinematicsPhases, REML=FALSE)
lm_kinPhase3 <- lmer(VALUE ~ GROUP*PHASE + (1|SUBJ_NUM), kinematicsPhases, REML=FALSE)
lm_kinPhase4 <- lmer(VALUE ~ GROUP+PHASE + (1|SUBJ_NUM), kinematicsPhases, REML=FALSE)

anova(lm_kinPhase1, lm_kinPhase2, lm_kinPhase3, lm_kinPhase4)
anova(lm_kinPhase1, lm_kinPhase3)

lm_kinPhase <- lmer(VALUE ~ GROUP*PHASE + (1|SUBJ_NUM), kinematicsPhases, REML=TRUE)
summary(lm_kinPhase)
anova(lm_kinPhase)

em_Group <- emmeans(lm_kinPhase, ~GROUP)
print(em_Group)
print(pairs(em_Group))

em_Phase <- emmeans(lm_kinPhase, ~PHASE)
print(em_Phase)
print(pairs(em_Phase, adjust='Holm'))

em_PG <- emmeans(lm_kinPhase, ~GROUP | PHASE)
print(em_PG)
print(pairs(em_PG, adjust='Holm'))

## ====================================================
#  Entropy stats
# =====================================================
entropyResults <- read.csv('entropyTable.txt')

lm_entropy1 <- lmer(Entropy ~ Group*Phase + (1+Phase||Subject), entropyResults, REML=FALSE)
lm_entropy2 <- lmer(Entropy ~ Group+Phase + (1+Phase||Subject), entropyResults, REML=FALSE)
lm_entropy3 <- lmer(Entropy ~ Group*Phase + (1|Subject), entropyResults, REML=FALSE)
lm_entropy4 <- lmer(Entropy ~ Group+Phase + (1|Subject), entropyResults, REML=FALSE)

anova(lm_entropy1, lm_entropy3, lm_entropy4)

lm_entropy <- lmer(Entropy ~ Group*Phase + (1|Subject), entropyResults, REML=TRUE)
summary(lm_entropy)
anova(lm_entropy)

em_Group <- emmeans(lm_entropy, ~Group)
print(em_Group)
print(pairs(em_Group))

em_Phase <- emmeans(lm_entropy, ~Phase)
print(em_Phase)
print(pairs(em_Phase, adjust='Holm'))

em_PG <- emmeans(lm_entropy, ~Group | Phase)
print(em_PG)
print(pairs(em_PG, adjust='Holm'))

# ====================================================
#  lme (relative to kinematic)
# ====================================================

original_trial_data_kinematic <- read.csv('longData.txt')
lmmod <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP * MUSCLE  + (1 |SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_kinematic, REML=FALSE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM)
lmmod_random <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP * MUSCLE  + (1 +MUSCLE||SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_kinematic, REML=FALSE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM)
lmmod_reduced <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP+MUSCLE  + (1|SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_kinematic, REML=FALSE) 


lmmod1 <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP * MUSCLE  + (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_kinematic, REML=FALSE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)
lmmod2 <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP + MUSCLE  + (1 + MUSCLE||SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_kinematic, REML=FALSE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)
lmmod3 <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP * MUSCLE  + (1 |SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_kinematic, REML=FALSE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)
lmmod4 <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP + MUSCLE  + (1 |SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_kinematic, REML=FALSE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)
anova(lmmod1,lmmod2,lmmod3,lmmod4)
anova(lmmod1,lmmod3)


lmmod1 <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP * MUSCLE  + (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_kinematic, REML=TRUE)
summary(lmmod1)
anova(lmmod1)

em_Group <- emmeans(lmmod1, ~GROUP, lmer.df='satterthwaite')
print(em_Group)
print(pairs(em_Group))

em_Muscle <- emmeans(lmmod1, ~MUSCLE,lmer.df='satterthwaite')
print(em_Muscle)
print(pairs(em_Muscle, adjust='Holm'))

em_MG <- emmeans(lmmod1, ~GROUP | MUSCLE,lmer.df='satterthwaite')
print(em_MG)
print(pairs(em_MG, adjust='Holm'))


# Estimate muscles within each group: Which muscles are significantly earlier or later than others within a given group?
em_pattern <- emmeans(lmmod1, ~ MUSCLE | GROUP, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
summary(em_pattern)
print(pairs(em_pattern,adjust = "holm"))
plot(em_pattern)

em <- emmeans(lmmod1, ~ GROUP * MUSCLE,
              lmer.df = "satterthwaite")

contrast(em,
         interaction = c("pairwise", "pairwise"),
         adjust = "holm")

nt_order <- em_df |>
  subset(GROUP == "NT") |>
  (\(x) x[order(x$emmean), ])() |>
  with(as.character(MUSCLE))

nt_order

em_df$MUSCLE <- factor(em_df$MUSCLE, levels = nt_order)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(em_df,
       aes(y = MUSCLE, x = emmean,
           color = GROUP)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower.CL,
                     xmax = upper.CL),
                 height = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~GROUP) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "Muscle (NT activation order)",
       x = "Estimated timing")
# ====================================================
#  lme (relative to biceps)
# ====================================================
original_trial_data_biceps <- read.csv('longDataToBiceps.txt')
lmmod <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP * MUSCLE  + (1 + MUSCLE||SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_biceps, REML=FALSE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)
lmmod_reduced <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP*MUSCLE  + (1|SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_biceps, REML=FALSE) 
lmmod_reduced <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP+MUSCLE  + (1|SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_biceps, REML=FALSE)

lmmod1 <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP * MUSCLE  + (1 + MUSCLE||SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_biceps, REML=FALSE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)
lmmod2 <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP + MUSCLE  + (1 + MUSCLE||SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_biceps, REML=FALSE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)
lmmod3 <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP * MUSCLE  + (1 |SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_biceps, REML=TRUE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)
lmmod4 <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP + MUSCLE  + (1 |SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_biceps, REML=FALSE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)
anova(lmmod1,lmmod2,lmmod3,lmmod4)
anova(lmmod1,lmmod3)

summary(lmmod1)
anova(lmmod)
anova(lmmod_reduced, lmmod)

lmmod <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP * MUSCLE  + (1 + MUSCLE||SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_biceps, REML=TRUE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)
lmmod <- lmer(Timing ~ GROUP * MUSCLE  + (1|SUBJ_NUM), original_trial_data_biceps, REML=TRUE) #+ (1 + MUSCLE|SUBJ_NUM) + (1 | SUBJ_NUM:TRIAL)

summary(lmmod)
anova(lmmod)

em_Group <- emmeans(lmmod, ~GROUP, lmer.df='satterthwaite')
print(em_Group)
print(pairs(em_Group))

em_Muscle <- emmeans(lmmod, ~MUSCLE, lmer.df='satterthwaite')
print(em_Muscle)
print(pairs(em_Muscle, adjust='Holm'))

em_MG <- emmeans(lmmod, ~GROUP | MUSCLE, lmer.df='satterthwaite')
print(em_MG)
print(pairs(em_MG, adjust='Holm'))

# Estimate muscles within each group: Which muscles are significantly earlier or later than others within a given group?
em_pattern <- emmeans(lmmod, ~ MUSCLE | GROUP, lmer.df = "satterthwaite")
summary(em_pattern)
pairs(em_pattern,adjust = "holm")
plot(em_pattern)

em_df <- as.data.frame(em_pattern)

nt_order <- em_df |>
  subset(GROUP == "NT") |>
  (\(x) x[order(x$emmean), ])() |>
  with(as.character(MUSCLE))

nt_order

em_df$MUSCLE <- factor(em_df$MUSCLE, levels = nt_order)

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(em_df,
       aes(y = MUSCLE, x = emmean,
           color = GROUP)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower.CL,
                     xmax = upper.CL),
                 height = 0.15) +
  facet_wrap(~GROUP) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(y = "Muscle (NT activation order)",
       x = "Estimated timing")
